$comment: COPY-IN registration for the agentic-sdlc hooks, not a live dependency. Merge this 'hooks' block into <project>/.claude/settings.json (alongside the permissions from settings.baseline.json). SessionStart lsp-preflight is detection only (no installs, no network), milliseconds. Stop/SubagentStop meter.sh is advisory and best-effort — it appends a cost record to .agentic-sdlc/meter/ and always exits 0. It finds meter.mjs in the plugin install cache (~/.claude/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/agentic-sdlc/<highest version>/), then the marketplace clone (~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/<marketplace>/plugins/agentic-sdlc/); set METER_MJS in the hook's environment to override. UserPromptSubmit/SessionEnd run-report.sh is the same advisory-and-best-effort contract, for run-report.mjs (RUN_REPORT_MJS overrides, same cache-then-marketplace resolution): UserPromptSubmit recognizes an /agentic-sdlc:plan, :build or :review prompt and marks the run's start or continuation in .agentic-sdlc/run-state.json, writing NOTHING to stdout on any path (that event's stdout is injected into the model's context); SessionEnd spawns the report build detached into .agentic-sdlc/runs/<run_id>.json so it never blocks on that event's time budget, which every SessionEnd hook shares. See templates/hooks/lsp-preflight.sh, templates/hooks/meter.sh and templates/hooks/run-report.sh for what each does and why.
